question: In which of the following states two Ayurveda Institutes were started on the 5th Ayurveda Day?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan and Gujarat.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Prime Minister dedicated two future-ready Ayurveda institutions to the nation at the 5th Ayurveda Day on 13th November 2020.
 
• These are the Institute of :
 
 
• Teaching & Research in Ayurveda (ITRA), Jamnagar, and 
 
• National Institute of Ayurveda (NIA), Jaipur.​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Ayurveda Day is being observed on** 29th October 2024**.
 
• The** theme **for this year is **Ayurved for students, Ayurved for farmers, Ayurved for public health​.**
